scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='index.html';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/\\n<!-- VERCEL_BUILD:[^>]*-->/g,'');s += '\\n<!-- VERCEL_BUILD:'+((process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA)||Date.now())+' -->\\n';fs.writeFileSync(p,s);console.log('Forced fresh static index build')"
